mapper.select: SELECT mr.id, mr.patient_id AS patientId, pt.name AS patientName, mr.doctor_id AS doctorId, d.name AS doctorName, mr.registration_id AS registrationId, mr.chief_complaint AS chiefComplaint, mr.present_illness AS presentIllness, mr.past_history AS pastHistory, mr.physical_exam AS physicalExam, mr.diagnosis, mr.treatment_plan AS treatmentPlan, mr.doctor_advice AS doctorAdvice, mr.visit_date AS visitDate, mr.create_time AS createTime FROM medical_record mr LEFT JOIN patient pt ON pt.id = mr.patient_id LEFT JOIN doctor d ON d.id = mr.doctor_id WHERE mr.id = #{id}

SELECT mr.id, mr.patient_id AS patientId, pt.name AS patientName, mr.doctor_id AS doctorId, d.name AS doctorName, mr.registration_id AS registrationId, mr.chief_complaint AS chiefComplaint, mr.present_illness AS presentIllness, mr.past_history AS pastHistory, mr.physical_exam AS physicalExam, mr.diagnosis, mr.treatment_plan AS treatmentPlan, mr.doctor_advice AS doctorAdvice, mr.visit_date AS visitDate, mr.create_time AS createTime FROM medical_record mr LEFT JOIN patient pt ON pt.id = mr.patient_id LEFT JOIN doctor d ON d.id = mr.doctor_id WHERE mr.patient_id = #{patientId} ORDER BY mr.visit_date DESC
